input.origin: Existing Bilibili 9.17.0 (9170100) APK, held locally by the user

algorithm: Real frozen DexMeguviz borrowed snapshot creation, method query, and consumption of every method row and text field; compare source hash, complete coverage, method count and result checksum.
completion_unit: One independent process/task, one full source parse and complete method enumeration; no allocation-only loop
A1: Conventional native System single dense 64-byte-aligned input backing, checked budget and refcount lifetime, existing borrowed-source parser API; all setup/memcpy/parse/query/full consumption/final release included
A3: Installed Memory ARENA with identical payload, alignment, initialization, source API, work, result lifetime and System backing; include domain/lease/owner admission and final collect/drain/destroy cost
preflight_budget_revision: Before pilot/formal sampling, full 54147-method query explicitly rejected the original 64 MiB parser budget. Preserve that failure; both A1/A3 now use a fixed 256 MiB parser budget. Memory input budget remains 32 MiB. No partial results or reduced work accepted.
preload_boundary: The same input file is read into a preloaded byte vector before the timed task in both variants; preload duration separately recorded. This is a CPU task elapsed metric, not APK open-to-result or host end-to-end latency.
timing_round: No provider tracing or detailed phase timers; only full-task elapsed. Own rusage and CPU metadata captured outside the elapsed boundary. Required semantic consumption and lifecycle checks remain enabled.
diagnostic_round: Separate --diagnostic runs with phase timers and resource fields, never pooled into formal timings.

limits.parser_internal_allocations: Remain owned by DexMeguviz; not injected into Memory or counted as its backing savings
limits.expected_opportunity: Input is already one dense System backing; no proven allocation or layout saving is assumed
limits.BIL_integration: Independent parser task is not the current BIL DexKit/player path. Even positive results require actual BIL hotpath/lifetime and bridge-cost qualification; no automatic switch.
